### `POST /api/projects/{project_id}/distillation/capture`

**Start Capture**

Start a teacher logit-capture job over a source dataset.

Validates the dataset belongs to the project (404 otherwise) before
detaching the per-row teacher calls onto the event loop. Returns the
task envelope immediately.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | `path` | `integer` | yes |  |

**Request body** (required)

Content type: `application/json` — `CaptureRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset_id` | `integer` | yes |  |
| `top_k` | `integer` | no |  |
| `teacher_model_name` | `string \\| null` | no |  |
| `limit` | `integer \\| null` | no |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Schema | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | `any` | Successful Response |
| `422` | `HTTPValidationError` | Validation Error |


### `GET /api/projects/{project_id}/distillation/tasks/{task_id}`

**Capture Task Status**

Poll a capture job for progress + results.

404 when the id is unknown (process restart / evicted / never created)
or belongs to a different project — don't leak cross-project state.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | `path` | `integer` | yes |  |
| `task_id` | `path` | `string` | yes |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Schema | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | `any` | Successful Response |
| `422` | `HTTPValidationError` | Validation Error |
